review_items: 61 candidate terms retain internal newline characters. These may be legitimate prose, line wrapping or additional source notes; do not split solely on line breaks.
Some free-text Objet entries consist of long passages. They remain a single candidate term when no explicit separator is present.
Canonical candidate chains are deduplicated across indexation entries while preserving source indexation IDs and document links.
Segmentation is mechanical and provisional. Terminology and business approval are separate processes.
